description.narrative: Stöd till Amhara kvinnliga företagarförening (AWEA). Projektet syftar till att stärka kapaciteten hos AWEA så att AWEA blir en stark medlems organisation och ger service till sina medlemmar på ett effektivt sätt. Förväntade resultat: förbättrad kapacitet hos föreningen, förbättra medlemsservice och inkomstgenererade aktiviteter.

Support to Amhara Women's Entrepreneurs Association (AWEA). Project purpose to further strengthen the capacity of AWEA to become a sustainable and effcient business member organisation providing services to its members. Expected results: Increaased operational efficiency 2) member services (provision of land, network service, BDS), c) income generating activities for AWEA.

The two applicable outcome objectives of the intervention are stated in the sustainability strategy and updated results framework agreed in 2015. Each outcome objective then has a large number of quantified output indicators. Outcome 1. Strengthened capacity of AWEA to deliver effective member led services as a viable, entity that contribute to women’s economic advancement in the Amhara Region Outcome 2. Financially self – sufficient and secured association

Results which were achieved under the two outcome objectives include the following (validated by the independent evaluation carried out in 2017) and an observation of the center by Sweden PO and Head of Development Section - Efficiency and credibility of AWEA increased significantly.- AWEA's service delivery capacity enhanced, hence increased working collaboration with different partners and local government authorities reaching to the extent of mainstreaming of AWEA activities- AWEA reached and serviced over its membership target (Now more than 30 000)- AWEA's Income has increased over time - income collected through trade fairs, membership fee, sponsorship, etc- AWEA's services for its members have increased, services include premises facilitated for large number of members, BDS facilitated for large number of members, credit service facilitated for large numbers of existing members- As of 2019, 100% of AWEA's operational costs were covered by AWEA's own source, for ex. a considerable portion of the activity budget was covered by other partners than Sida (Birr 2,254,644).- In 2019 the establishment of the business center has been finalized and offically handed over to AWEA secretariat. This is expected to generated additional income for the association.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
